bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge code, `msg_write` was asserted for every TL-UL write to the message-FIFO window (`msg_fifo_req & msg_fifo_we & ~hmac_fifo_wsel`) regardless of whether a hash operation was active. This let software push message data into the packer/message FIFO before `hash_start` or after `hash_process`, potentially filling/backpressuring the FIFO and locking the core. The root cause is the lack of an enable/window control gating software MSG_FIFO writes from hash start until process/flush completion.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a `msg_allowed` flag, reset to 0, set when `hash_start` is accepted, and cleared when `packer_flush_done` signals the end of the message push window. Include this flag in the `msg_write` assignment alongside the existing FIFO window/we conditions so MSG_FIFO writes outside the active operation are dropped instead of being accepted and backpressuring the TL-UL path.
